comparison.objective: Candidate fractures and recovers HELICOIL tangs; record pulls an extinguisher retaining pin, reads its gauge, and files a matching tag.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial impact tooling and fragment collection; record requires linear pin extraction, visual gauge classification, and tag placement.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four clean fractures and four contained tangs without damage; record requires at least 2 cm of rested pin displacement plus a tag within 2.5 cm of the correct state pad.
comparison.reason: Pin withdrawal plus gauge-dependent reporting tests different mechanical and perceptual abilities.
